Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — The reporter circled the Facebook/Twitter share icons in the file row of the Mixdrop page mxdrop.click, which the AdGuard Social Media filter did not hide. A domain-scoped element-hiding rule for those two anchors validated in the reporter's own settings profile:⁠ the icons are gone, no residue, page intact. ## Rule `mxdrop.click##.s-wrapper > .sc` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The report is a social widget (Facebook/Twitter share buttons) and matches the stated purpose of the AdGuard Social Media filter, which blocks social media widgets such as Share buttons on third-party sites; the icons are not part of the site's functionality such as comments or social login. No policy rule in the run instruction closes it:⁠ it is not the site's own advertising, not a paywall, not an anti-adblock wall, and not a scam/phishing page. Site traffic is not a blocking concern for this widely used file-hosting platform family that already has rules in the repository. ## Place in the list [SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/0cbe282a7b179745c082e2d570fc4e9d4b110538/SocialFilter/sections/specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"cb99c89671a9a41735df7710b73f9dee7411cc3075a87c93cdd9f7645bfe2c50"} -->
The filter policy recommends closing without a rule

## Reproduced symptom

The banner the reporter circled on nove3cinco.pt is the site's own first-party ad inventory:⁠ a publisher-hosted sponsor carousel (div#⁠banner, slides linking to froiz.pt and six other advertisers) with creatives on nove3cinco.pt's own uploads and no ad network request anywhere in the page's traffic. The repository policy that the site's own first-party advertising is not deliberately blocked therefore calls for recommending close rather than a rule.

## Policy rationale

Run instruction filter policy:⁠ "The site's own advertising (first-party ads):⁠ no rule; recommend closing." The reporter-defined target is a first-party ad served by the publisher itself, so the fix is blocked by this rule rather than by missing evidence. KnowledgeBase filter policy (served via lookup_rule_guidance):⁠ "The site's own advertising should not be deliberately blocked. However, it should not be unblocked if the blocking is caused by general filtering rules." A dedicated rule for this banner would deliberately block it; the banner is not blocked by any general rule today (get_applied_rules shows only four Tracking Protection scriptlets acting on the page). The report is not anti-adblock, not a paywall and not a scam/phishing page, so none of the other policy bullets applies; only the first-party-advertising bullet governs it.

## Artifacts

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — The reporter's screenshot shows an unlabelled Amazon Music promotional card in the right sidebar of the tomshw.it article; it is a third-party iframe from music.amazon.it/embed carrying affiliate parameters (irpid, ircid, iradid). Live evidence in the reporter's own settings profile confirms it, and EasyList Italy (defaults_plus_required comparison) does not cover it either. The proposed element-hiding rule hides that embed on tomshw.it; the browser experiment verified the ad disappears, no layout residue remains and the article is intact. ## Rule `tomshw.it##iframe[src^="https://music.amazon.it/embed/"]` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The report is an advertising complaint (label T:⁠ Ads) about a third-party Amazon affiliate/promotional embed served from music.amazon.it with affiliate tracking parameters (irpid, ircid, iradid), not the site's own first-party ad creative:⁠ the repository already treats Amazon offer units on tomshw.it as removable (tomshw.it#⁠%#⁠//scriptlet('json-prune-fetch-response', 'components.[⁠-]⁠.snapshot.[⁠=]⁠./www\⁠.amazon\⁠./', '', 'livewire/update') and tomshw.it#⁠#⁠div[⁠wire\⁠:⁠snapshot*="offer"]⁠). Not a paywall, not a German anti-adblock wall and not an anti-adblock gate at all, so none of the instruction's close-without-rule cases applies. ## Place in the list [ItalianFilter/sections/specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/0cbe282a7b179745c082e2d570fc4e9d4b110538/ItalianFilter/sections/specific.txt) Next to the site's existing rules, before [line 45](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/0cbe282a7b179745c082e2d570fc4e9d4b110538/ItalianFilter/sections/specific.txt#L45). ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |

Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The reported "Please disable your ad blocker to continue." notice on upfilesgo.com could not be reproduced:⁠ it never renders on the loaded page with the reporter's filters, and the download-button click that triggers it is refused by the sandbox, so no phase can reach the reporter's step. Analysis is handed over with the detector for the gate and an unverified neutralizer candidate for human review.

## Candidate for review

`upfilesgo.com#%#(()=>{let v;Object.defineProperty(window,'vhit',{configurable:true,get(){return v},set(o){v=o;try{Object.defineProperty(o,'detectAdblock',{configurable:true,get(){return()=>!1},set(){}})}catch(e){}}})})();`

BaseFilter/sections/antiadblock.txt

Not verified: The reported symptom could not be observed in any phase. With the reporter's filters the notice never renders on the loaded page (DOM text search and full-page vision both show it absent), and the step that makes it appear — clicking form#⁠free-download-form button#⁠link-button-free after the five-second countdown — is refused by interact_page with refusalReason "publication", which also makes it unavailable to apply_rule revealSteps. apply_rule therefore returned environmentExperiment "inconclusive" (errorKind baseline_symptom_absent, validationSkipped true) and never judged the rule. Supporting (not validating) evidence:⁠ the repo's existing neutralizer, scriptlet('set-constant','window.vhit.detectAdblock','noopFunc'), produces no hit in the engine log and the live /_v/s.js function remains the site's real obfuscated detector, so this rule re-implements that intent as a trap on window.vhit that survives the site assigning the object.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Missing information

- No route to rehearse a symptom triggered by a download/publish control that interact_page refuses: The reported symptom ("AdGuard detected ... upon clicking the final download button") requires clicking form#⁠free-download-form button#⁠link-button-free on https:⁠//upfilesgo.com/zQe8. interact_page refuses that click with refusalReason "publication" (executedSteps 0), and apply_rule's revealSteps uses the same step grammar, so no phase can ever reach the page state the reporter describes. The run instruction says nothing about how to reproduce a symptom behind a control the sandbox classifies as unsafe, so the anti-adblock notice could not be produced, observed, or validated in any phase.

## Artifacts

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/43551374188

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"59b978ee61defb79255b9bd8fdaf0e2f72152207bdc36285082f6404bcc8cfac"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The reporter's blank "adv space data-preview-ad" band under the header is real and caused by a `[data-preview-ad]` wrapper that keeps a fixed 287px height after the inner `.ad-frame` slot is hidden; hiding it closed the band with page integrity intact, but the vision review kept rejecting every candidate because it also treats the page's own empty 300px sidebar grid track as the same symptom, and that space cannot be cleared without deleting the site's "Caffè Scorretto" promo. No rule was verified, so this run reports the analysis and the low-risk rule `unionesarda.it##[data-preview-ad]` (ItalianFilter/sections/specific.txt) for human review.

## Still visible after the rule

- Per approfondire list / article body, right-hand column beside it (below the 'Un po' di calma' CaffèScorretto box seen at the top of tile 1) — The full-height right-hand ad rail (about 300 px wide, from the column divider at x≈1222 to the container edge) is completely blank white beside the article text and the 'Per approfondire' list. No ad creative, ad label, frame, divider or placeholder block is rendered anywhere in the column, yet the column keeps its reserved ad width/height for the whole length of the article. This is the reporter's 'companion blank reserved ad column' repeating below the header band.
- Right-hand rail beside the lower multimedia article list — Blank reserved right-hand ad rail/column; a vertical divider/frame is visible but no ad creative or label is rendered in it. This matches the companion blank reserved ad column described by the reporter.
- Right-hand rail beside the ARTICOLI CORRELATI grid — Blank reserved right-hand ad rail/column continues beside the related-article section; the divider/frame is visible, but the reserved ad space contains no creative or ad label.
- Right-hand rail beside the related-article grid and above the footer — Blank reserved right-hand ad rail/column continues through this tile with a visible divider/frame and no rendered ad creative.
- Right-hand rail beside the lower-page multimedia row above the footer (Quartu / Massimo Zedda / Violenza di genere) — Blank reserved right-hand column alongside the multimedia cards, bounded by the page's thin vertical column rule and containing no ad creative or ad label. This matches the reported empty right-rail advertising space.
- and 1 more of the same, in the run artifacts

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

## Missing information

- Reporter's language filter "AdGuard Italian" (id 26) is not resolvable in the locked filter baseline: The issue's reporter settings import lists `regular_filters=2,3,4,17,18,19,20,21,22,26`, where 26 is "AdGuard Italian" (the language filter that holds this Italian site's rules, e.g. ItalianFilter/sections/specific.txt line 252-255 for unionesarda.it). The locked environment's filterBaseline reported `skippedSources: [{kind: "unresolved_name", reportedName: "AdGuard Italian"}]`, and the reporter-profile launch answer's enabledLists contained only filters 2,3,4,17,18,19,20,21,22. Consequently no session in this run could apply or validate against the exact list the reporter had enabled; I fell back to repository search_rules hits for ItalianFilter to inventory that site's existing rules, and to a `defaults_plus_required` session (which loaded id 10 and EasyList Italy id 109 instead) for the controlled comparison. If exact reporter-list baseline is required for parity, the Italian filter source needs to be resolvable in the fixed environment.

Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — shii4u.media (Arabic streaming site, shahid4u clone family) shows a centered anti-adblock modal asking visitors to disable their ad blocker, and locks the page body (inline overflow:⁠hidden) so nothing below the fold can be reached. Its inline detector fires from the blocked Google ad script; a scriptlet that stops the blocked script's onerror handler was verified in the reporter's AdGuard Browser Extension MV3 configuration (gate gone, page intact, no scroll lock). ## Rule `shii4u.media#%#//scriptlet('prevent-element-src-loading', 'script', 'pagead2.googlesyndication.com')` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale No run-instruction rule closes this report:⁠ it is not the site's own advertising, not a paywall, and not a German anti-adblock wall — the page is Arabic and the wall itself reports the ad blocker. It is another anti-adblock wall, and the requests captured in the reporter session show the detector's script request (https:⁠//pagead2.googlesyndication.com/pagead/js/adsbygoogle.js?client=ca-pub-xxxx, blocked, artifact:⁠har:⁠69c258b3-ef00-47ba-a17e-0b741ea7216b) whose error handler creates div.ignielAdBlock, so a rule may be written. The wall aggressively withholds use of the site:⁠ it overlays the carousel and sets body overflow:⁠hidden, so the filter policy's anti-adblock criteria are met. A verified candidate exists, so the outcome is a rule proposal rather than a close or hand-off. ## Place in the list [BaseFilter/sections/antiadblock.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/0cbe282a7b179745c082e2d570fc4e9d4b110538/BaseFilter/sections/antiadblock.txt) By adding the domain to the existing rule on [line 2174](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/0cbe282a7b179745c082e2d570fc4e9d4b110538/BaseFilter/sections/antiadblock.txt#L2174). ## Screenshots

comment.body:
Candidate rule proposed ## Reproduced symptom Reproduced — On joybuggy.com/pl a first-party "Witamy" cookie-consent dialog (ToS checkbox, "Akceptuj wszystkie"/"Tylko niezbędne"/"Ustawienia") is drawn over the storefront and no list hides it; it also appears with the controlled defaults profile, so it is a gap in the Cookie Notices filter rather than a configuration artifact. The domain-scoped element-hiding rule joybuggy.com#⁠#⁠[⁠data-testid="onboarding-modal"]⁠ was verified by apply_rule (symptom resolved, page intact, no residue). ## Rule `joybuggy.com##[data-testid="onboarding-modal"]` ## Executor and version Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3 ## Policy rationale The report is a cookie-consent notice, not the site's own advertising, not a paywall, and not an anti-adblock wall; the run instruction's policy rules therefore do not close it. Filter policy for the AdGuard Cookie Notices filter states that in most cases simply hiding the corresponding element or blocking its scripts is sufficient, which is what this rule does. No existing rule covers joybuggy.com and no shared rule family matches the banner, so a new domain-scoped rule is the appropriate form. ## Place in the list [AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt](https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/0cbe282a7b179745c082e2d570fc4e9d4b110538/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt) At the end of the file. ## Screenshots
Without and with the rule | Without the rule | With the rule | |---|---| | | |
## Artifacts https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/43556708910 Automated analysis against filters at `0cbe282`. Posted by a filters agent; a maintainer reviews before anything is merged.

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"1f3dabbe66a5b941ded4155f4af3ee918a84813f7cc7a33013fd12b2d568a692"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The reporter's annotated blank band is the leftover of birgun.net's unfilled `[data-section="ad-slot-belowhero"]` ad slot (343x280 px, min-height 280 px from the site's CSS, empty because the slot's fill request `||birgun.net/api/Ads/AdsGetList` is blocked by the AdGuard Turkish filter), and a domain-scoped hide removed it with page integrity intact. Both candidate experiments were nevertheless rejected by the vision review for large blank bands deep in the page's dynamically appended "next content" feed, where no ad element occupies height at all, so no candidate could be verified and none can be carried under the run's contract.

## Still visible after the rule

- Document y=5868..6680, between the article date/font-size controls and the police photo — A large blank white band roughly 280 px tall spans the article column between the date/font-size controls and the following photo. No ad creative, REKLAMA label, frame, or placeholder block is visible in it, consistent with a residual unfilled ad slot.
- Article body, between the paragraph ending “...gerçekleşmeden biliyorduk” dedi.” and the uppercase heading “HER ŞEYİ BİZ YAPTIK GEREKİRSE HER YERİ YIKARIZ” — A visibly oversized blank white vertical band spans the article column between the paragraph and the following uppercase heading. It is much taller than the normal paragraph spacing and shows no ad creative, label, frame, or placeholder block, matching a residual empty ad slot.
- between the paragraph ending “...cezaevine gönderiyorlar” and the heading “AYNI KOĞUŞA KONULDU” — A large blank white band spanning the article column sits between the body copy and the “AYNI KOĞUŞA KONULDU” heading. No ad creative, REKLAMA label, frame, divider, or placeholder block is visible in the gap, so it reads as reserved/unfilled ad-slot whitespace.
- Above '19 KASIM'DA HAKİM KARŞISINA ÇIKACAK' heading, below embedded quote ending at https:⁠//t.co/JS8W7blvu — A large blank white band spanning the article column, visibly taller than ordinary paragraph or heading spacing, appears after the embedded quote/link and before the next section heading. No ad creative, REKLAMA label, frame or placeholder block is visible, consistent with an unfilled ad slot.
